title: Normalized quotient-diagram exchange presentation
statement: For small sites X,Y, a geometric inverse image with its constant-coefficient algebraic lift, a commutative ring A and an ideal I [def-pur-adic-site-strict-quotient-interface], use the strict quotient diagonal presentations [def-pur-strict-quotient-diagonal-presentation]. Modules are the actual quotient-ring sheaves on the sequence site. Evaluation retains quotient coefficients. A reduction presentation records ordinary scalar extension, its finite and strict derived comparisons, and scalar-restriction evaluation. Presentation records the quotient-diagram module adjunction and its ordinary and derived restriction, reduction and evaluation comparisons. ReductionNormalized and PresentationNormalized fix the ordinary section/Hom equations and the entire K-flat cochain comparison squares. The arrows exchange, restrictionMate, strictExchange and finiteExchange are the counit-defined adjunction mates with the displayed endpoint comparisons. completionExchange is the derived strict limit of strictExchange conjugated by the reduction comparisons and directLimitIso. These definitions are relocated verbatim from the parent theorem module; no existence, invertibility or compatibility equation is assumed.
